description: This file defines the MediaLibraryUiBuilder class, a service responsible for building the media library user interface in Drupal, including dialog options, UI rendering, access control, media type menu, add form, and view rendering.

classes.name: MediaLibraryUiBuilder
classes.description: A service class that constructs the media library UI, manages access, and integrates with Drupal's view and form systems.

methods.name: dialogOptions
methods.description: Returns configuration options for the media library dialog, including classes, title, height, and width.

methods.name: buildUi
methods.description: Builds the main media library UI, either loading specific content or rendering the wrapper with menu and content.

methods.name: buildLibraryContent
methods.description: Constructs the content area of the media library, including form and view components.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Performs access control checks for viewing the media library based on user permissions and view existence.

methods.name: buildMediaTypeMenu
methods.description: Creates a menu for selecting media types if multiple types are available.

methods.name: buildMediaTypeAddForm
methods.description: Generates the form for adding new media of the selected type, considering access permissions.

methods.name: buildMediaLibraryView
methods.description: Prepares and renders the media library view with current state parameters.
